Drawn as if 64x64 pixels upscaled with nearest neighbour. No text, no border, no watermark, single subject. Subject: a detached giant rust-red piston arm hanging vertically from a short chain, ending in a squared trip-hammer head with glowing yellow seams; hydraulic pistons along its length; no body attached.
attempts.review: Chain clipped by top canvas edge; rejected.
